title: Full-keypoint DINO semantic-part-query oracle gate
hypothesis: Cross-class semantic keypoint supervision can fit a detector in frozen DINOv2 patch-token space whose inferred part pooling improves held-out few-shot classification beyond both uniform pooling and CLS-only RBF.

features.cache: PAT-H-260729-001 CLS float32, mean patch float32, dense patch float16, and semantic keypoint patch indices

semantic_detector.labels: 15 named semantic parts plus one background class
semantic_detector.positive_tokens: one DINO patch token at every visible fold-training keypoint
semantic_detector.background_exclusion: Chebyshev distance at least 3 tokens from every visible keypoint
semantic_detector.background_sampling: deterministic per outer fold and row index
semantic_detector.outer_evaluation_keypoints: metrics only; forbidden from detector and classifier fitting

part_pooling.full: for each part, z-score detector logits over 784 patches, spatial softmax at temperature 1.0, then weighted-pool original normalized patch tokens
part_pooling.k0: set all detector logits to zero, yielding uniform spatial pooling with identical output dimensions
part_pooling.part_aggregation: equal mean over 15 normalized part vectors
part_pooling.final_representation: equal concatenation of L2-normalized CLS and L2-normalized aggregate part vector, followed by L2 normalization

arms.CLS_RBF: L2-normalized CLS plus RBF SVC C=3 gamma=scale using SVC.predict
arms.K0_UNIFORM_PART_RBF: CLS plus zero-detector uniform part pooling, same RBF
arms.FULL_SEMANTIC_PART_RBF: CLS plus Full semantic part pooling, same RBF

localization_metric.name: 3x3-token hit rate
localization_metric.definition: predicted part argmax lies within Chebyshev distance 1 of a visible held-out keypoint patch

selection_rule.on_success: freeze a separate K1 sparse-budget protocol; do not access official test
selection_rule.on_fail: stop semantic-part-query route; do not tune detector alpha, background count, temperature, representation weights, or classifier

reporting: standard SVC.predict balanced accuracy for all arms
held-out localization hit counts and rates
positive and negative class counts versus K0
worst class recall delta versus K0
complete OOF predictions and predicted semantic patch indices
